Убийството ни събра. Единствено смъртта може да ни раздели.

Преследвачът
Калиста Грийн ми принадлежи... просто не го знае. Още при първата ни среща я пожелах. При следващата вече бях обсебен от нея. Наблюдавах я. Следях я. Това само разпалваше нуждата ми да я притежавам. Когато бъде моя, никога няма да я пусна.

Целта
Хайдън Бенет е чудовище – и в съдебната зала, и извън нея. За съжаление, имам нужда от помощта му. Трябваше да е най-обикновена сделка, но се оказа нещо много по-различно. По-сложно. Той винаги е до мен, когато ми трябва, а не знам дали е добра идея да му се доверя...

Това издание на „Kогато бъдеш моя“ съдържа бонус глава и първите глави на втората книга от дилогията „Покорена“.

*This book is part of a series and ends on a cliffhanger*

I'm not going to read the second book, I'll start by saying that. I just have no desire to know where the story goes as it's already so incredibly ridiculous. Our MMC is assaulting people in public .... in front of crowds - and just walking away from it without repercussion. Our FMC has a head full of rocks - honestly .... she can't figure out who is stalking her? Never mind that the MMC shows up everywhere she is ... never mind that the MMC assaults others who touch her and tells her over and over he'll kill anyone that does because she is his. (Spoiler alert, he does kill men who are interested in her) Never mind the FMC concluding she has a stalker and her only evidence is that he's leaving a pearl from her necklace on her bed side table each night. So....then that means she's sleeping just fine .... every night ... knowing someone is breaking into her home to leave said pearl? We live in an age of wireless camera's .... come on now, she isn't even trying to figure it out? She's to the point of fearing for others, yet she hasn't gone to the police? It makes ZERO sense. She is so unbearably dense that it was unbelievable to see her as a capable adult in any capacity. I just started skimming pages until I finished - and the only reason it's a two star is because I did, in fact, finish it.

Don't waste your time with this one - if you want a good stalker romance; try The Pucking Wrong Number or The Pucking Wrong Guy by CR Jane. Haunting Adeline if you want a dark stalker romance. Everything for Her if you want a billionaire stalking romance. I could go on and on - there are so many better options for stalker romance....

This was the Wish version of Haunting Adeline.

I don’t even know where to start with this. So I’ll start with the only good thing about it - this was a very MILD dark romance. & there was consent before they had sex, which was a nice change of pace compared to other very intense dark romances.

Other than someone looking for a super mild version of this genre, I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

Like I said in the first line, the author obviously took all inspiration from Haunting Adeline when she wrote this book. The stalking, the ‘I’ll kill anyone who touches you’ vibe, the leaving pearls at her bedside (like roses), the side character being the “only guy he trusts” that he can call for help when he needs it (like Jay), her having only 1 girl best friend (like Daya) and lastly the line where it LITERALLY mentions cat & mouse and MMC changes it to her being “little bird” instead... Lol I MEAN COME ON.

I don’t get how a lawyer has all these skills to back up him killing people and getting away with it. The plot was so lazily written. This is by far the worst writing I have ever read in a book. The first 50 pages felt like it was trying to be poetry?? and then after that it was just like she was trying way too hard to sound smart… it truly felt like a middle schooler / early high schooler wrote this. There was no depth to anything. It was so rushed through. I didn’t connect with any characters. It ended on a cliff hanger (also like haunting Adeline lol) but I won’t be reading the second in the series or anything else from this author. 👎

This book follows Calista Green, daughter of a politician who’s hiding secrets from her past, and Hayden Bennett, a brilliant, ruthless, and highly possessive prosecuting attorney, extremely obsessive man who becomes completely fixated on her after a tragic incident. Hayden basically turns into her stalker, always watching over her and trying to “protect” her in his own messed up way.

The story contains suspense and dark romance elements, but honestly, Hayden’s obsession felt too much for me at times 😭
I am used to reading dark romance, but I didn't understand their chemistry build up. Some people may enjoy the possessive energy, I just couldn’t fully connect with it.

——⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑————⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑————⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑————⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑——

The book at a glance :

Calista : she has a stalker and needs money to buy a security system, but then she went straight to the stalker himself to make a deal 🤣

Hayden : visits her apartment every night after she falls asleep, leaves a pearl in her nightstand and tells "one pearl for one drop of cu- 👀

——⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑————⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑————⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑————⭑⋆⋆⋆⭑——

One thing I did enjoy was Harper 😂 Every time she mentioned Hayden Bennett she came up with the funniest nicknames, and her scenes honestly made the book more entertaining for me.

The story ends on a cliffhanger, let's see what happens in the second book.

It wasn’t terrible, but it just didn’t hit the way I hoped it would.

I‘m sorry. I tried to read it but this book didn‘t pull me in AT ALL.

It felt so juvenile, so teenager-Wattpad-fanfiction. I honestly expected Bennett to look like [insert ex One Direction/any K-Pop group member].

My biggest issue though was with the reality check. I‘m sorry but the daughter of a high-profile politician is not very likely to need to be working a shitty job because she can‘t get her cents together. Like what?! Who the hell thought that was realistic in ANY multiverse??

A senator‘s daughter WILL have the necessary kind of daddy‘s money to not be needing to do that. She WILL have the kind of connections to snatch up a high class job. But beeing so poor - bordering on homelessness - that you need to work a shitty barkeeper job at the next best Hooters for Sons of Anarchy gangsters? Nah, not very fucking believable.

And where the hell is her mom at? Because I think I missed the memo of what happened to her mom.

So yeah … I really AM digging dark romance novels and I will overlook some extent of absent logic (hi, H.D. Carlton) but this one just didn‘t do it for me.

Omg I loved this way more than I thought I would! This ticks so many boxes for a dark romance!

Hayden Bennett is a top attorney who was the prosecutor on Callie’s Dads case. He also murdered Callie’s father unbeknownst to her, but he now thinks her father could’ve been innocent. Through being connected to the case he becomes obsessed with Callie and that then develops into feelings for her. He’s extremely morally grey, posssive and complete touch her and 💀 vibes. He literally pinned a man’s hand to a bar and set fire to him & the building for wanting to sleep with Callie 😭😭😭 he’s unhinged and I ATE IT UP 🤣

"I still want you... even though you have been raped/assaulted."

What the fuck, Author?

This was so close to being a 2.5 or 3-star rating for me, because the stalker trope is one of my weaknesses...

I was even willing to overlook the annoying best friend of the FMC, who is a total caricature btw. Her life literally revolves around the FMC's sex life for some reason, and every word out of her mouth is a try-hard sexual innuendo...

Like, this is not funny or quirky. Her character just comes off as unnatural at best and annoying at worst, and my eyes are constantly rolling to the back of my head whenever she's in a scene...

But the final straw was that scene with the FMC and MMC.

The MMC finds out the FMC may have been assaulted...

Then the FMC, for some reason, questions her desirability to the MMC...?

The MMC then reassures the FMC that she is desirable to him...

Um... okay...

I don’t think authors know how to write romance anymore.

What the fuck was that?

We need a makeover in the romance book community! ASAP
